sourceFile: 05. L20S15-07 Report test new lot CD .SIZE 490K ( Ivn   IR250410013 ) and lot CD size  210K (Ivn  IR250412022 ) Use new CD load tray_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source evidence but misgroups the primary changed factor and several outcome conditions.
issues: Primary factor is not a normal-vs-test comparison; it is qualification of new CD lots with new load tray.
Lot numbers are mixed into changedCondition as separate conditions instead of subgroup keys.
Outcome extraction is misaligned; dyne, tension, separation, function NG, and decision results are conflated.
Tension spec is omitted from subresults, limiting pass/fail interpretation.
Decision rows approving/rejecting specific lots are not cited in the case evidence.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this case be framed as lot qualification only, with no baseline comparison?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new CD lots 490K and 210K using new CD load tray.
Use CD size/invoice as condition and lot numbers as subgroup keys.
Separate dyne, tension, VP/CD separation, function NG, and final decision outcomes under one case.
Add tension spec 1.2 kgf and preserve lot-level pass notes.
Cite purpose, result headers, lot result rows, tension rows, and decision rows 54-56.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient until decision rows and corrected lot-level grouping are cited.
